# Test fixtures

Every file here is synthetic: written for Revise's tests, with fictional
content.

| File                                   | What it is                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `legal-negotiation-before.docx`        | A fictional five-page services agreement (Northstar Analytics and Cedar Vale Research), generated with python-docx |
| `legal-negotiation-after-clean.docx`   | The same agreement after a negotiation, exported by Revise with the changes accepted                               |
| `legal-negotiation-after-tracked.docx` | The same negotiation, exported by Revise with the changes as tracked revisions                                     |
| `table.rtf`                            | A two-cell RTF table, written by hand                                                                              |
| `image.png`                            | A 48×24 gradient, generated by a script                                                                            |
